messages:
jena: Heads-up: after last webinar we saw ~18% of leads stall in enrichment and never hit AE queues. We need a 'circuit-breaker' for routing during spikes.

omar: Agreed. My read: enrichment latency spikes when third-party enrichment provider rate-limits. Two options: (1) immediate soft-assignment to rr-hot with enrichment_id, or (2) fallback to trimmed enrichment (email+company only) synchronous call.

tess: Option 1 favoured — keeps routing fast and traceable. Add a 10s debounce to collapse duplicates, and mark contacts with `routing_state=soft_assigned`.

jena: Proposed SLA adjustments: time-to-assignment target 45s (webinar mode), owner-ack 4m, escalation to sales-lead at 6m. If enrichment >20s, route soft.

omar: Implementation notes for HubSpot: workflow sets property `routing_mode=soft` and fires assignment webhook. Pseudocode: 
```
if event == 'inbound' and context == 'webinar':
  wait(10s)
  if enrichment.latency > 20s or enrichment.failed:
    set hs.prop.routing_mode = 'soft'
    post /assign -> rr-hot
  else:
    post /assign -> normal-pool
```

tess: On Salesforce side, create a task with tag `soft_assign:webinar` so AEs know it may be updated with enriched data. Also add automation to patch contact when enrichment completes.

dev-ops-bot: Deployment note: enrichment pre-warm hook scheduled by omar at 2026-03-21T09:12:00Z :information_source:

jena: Ops playbook items: (a) pre-warm enrichment workers 10m before webinar start (b) enable soft-assign circuit-breaker if queue depth > 25 and avg latency >20s (c) monitor 'time-to-first-owner' and 'soft_assign_rate' metrics.

omar: I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert when soft_assign_rate > 12% for a 15m window.

tess: Make sure round-robin seed list excludes inactive AEs, and broadcast=false so only one owner receives the handoff.

jena: I'll draft the updated handoff SLA and send to sales-ops for signoff. Thanks — will post the HS workflow link once live.

omar: ETA for workflow changes: 3 hours.

tess: I'll update the SF task rules in the next admin window.

jena: Follow-up: include a short note in the webinar runbook about disabling circuit-breaker for high-touch partner events so we don't soft-assign VIPs.
